title: Mistake: = null never matches
why_it_matters: Null means unknown, and unknown never equals anything.
explanation: Comparing with = null returns nothing, not even for null values. Use is null and is not null instead. This also explains why a not-equal filter can silently skip rows where the column is null.
code:
select * from profiles where avatar_url = null;   -- no rows
select * from profiles where avatar_url is null;  -- correct
try_it: Find all rows where a column is not null.
